title_sq: Shiten 3 apartamente 1+1 ne rrugen e Barrikadave!
description_sq:
Shiten 3 apartamente me strukture 1+1 te gatshme per dhenie me qira ne Airbnb, Booking etj. Ndodhen në një pallat të ri tepër cilësor, vendodhja e të cilit është fare pranë qendrës, afer me Gjimnazin “Sami Frasheri”.
Godina ku ndodhet apartamenti është 11 kate, ku 2 katet e para janë ambiente shërbimi dhe 3 kate parkim. Ofron rifinitura shumë cilësore, fasadë e ventiluar me Gress Porcelanate, shkallet me dritë nga kati +5 e lart, ambientet e përbashkëta me mermer, 4 apartamente në kat, 2 ashensor etj.
Apartamentet shitet te mobiluara si ne foto.
Mundesi per 2 poste parkimi me cmim extra.
Disponojne dokumentacion te rregull hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion apo per nje vizite ne prone mund te me kontaktoni!
title_en: 3 1+1 apartments for sale in Barrikadave street!
description_en: 3 apartments for sale with 1+1 structure, ready for renting on Airbnb, Booking, etc. They are located in a very high-quality new building, the location of which is very close to the center, close to the "Sami Frasheri" Gymnasium. The building where the apartment is located has 11 floors, where the first 2 floors are service facilities and 3 parking floors. It offers high-quality refinishing, ventilated facade with Gress Porcelanate, stairs with light from floor +5 and above, common areas with marble, 4 apartments on the floor, 2 elevators, etc. The apartments are sold furnished as in the photo. Possibility of 2 parking spaces at an extra cost. They have proper mortgage documentation. For more information or for a visit to the property, you can contact me!
